name: custtoolset_pillar12_extractor
description: Catalogs the broader digital ecosystem interacting with NetSuite, mapping active external integrations and evaluating the organization's SDF deployment maturity.

analysisType.description: The specific extensibility metric to analyze. Use 'external_topology' to map active middleware and OAuth/TBA integrations, or 'extensibility_framework' to evaluate the ratio of SDF-deployed projects versus manual UI uploads.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing the topology of authorized external integrations or the deployment origin statistics of active scripts.
